components.name: Trailhead Primary Button
components.description: The single action that turns a venue link into the next step.
components.css: .ds-trailhead-cta { display:inline-flex; height:56px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; background:var(--app-accent); color:var(--app-accent-ink); padding:16px 20px; font:600 12px/16px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }.ds-trailhead-cta:hover { background:var(--app-accent-hover); }.ds-trailhead-cta:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--app-focus); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--app-focus) 30%,transparent); }.ds-trailhead-cta:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Trailhead URL Field
components.description: The centered venue or event URL instrument.
components.html: <input class="ds-trailhead-input" type="url" aria-label="Venue or event URL" placeholder="https://venue.com/event">
components.css: .ds-trailhead-input { height:56px; border:1px solid var(--app-field-border); border-radius:0; background:var(--app-field); color:var(--app-field-ink); padding:16px; font:400 18px/27px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; }.ds-trailhead-input::placeholder { color:var(--app-field-placeholder); }.ds-trailhead-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--app-focus); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--app-focus) 30%,transparent); }

components.name: Shared Product Bar
components.description: The same 56px navigation treatment on / and /status.
components.html: BeforeDoorsKnow before you goSystem status
components.css: .ds-product-bar { display:flex; height:56px; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--app-line); background:var(--app-bg); color:var(--app-ink); padding:0 20px; font-family:"Inter Variable",sans-serif; }.ds-product-bar a { color:inherit; }.ds-product-bar button { width:32px; height:32px; border:1px solid var(--app-line); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; }

components.name: Diagnostic Receipt
components.description: The live connection record rendered on the shared Trailhead surface.
components.css: .ds-status-record { width:min(100%,704px); min-height:100%; margin:0 auto; border-right:1px solid var(--app-line); border-left:1px solid var(--app-line); border-radius:0; background:var(--app-bg); color:var(--app-ink); }.ds-status-record section,.ds-status-record dl { border-color:var(--app-line); }.ds-status-record dt { color:var(--app-muted); }.ds-status-record dd { color:var(--app-ink); border-left:1px solid var(--app-line); }.ds-status-record [role="status"] { color:var(--status-pending); }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: A text-first state label with a reserved semantic marker.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--app-muted); font:400 14px/20px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; }.ds-status > span { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:currentColor; }

narrative.overview: BeforeDoors uses one visual world across the homepage and system status route: warm map paper, deep evergreen ink, a bright orange route signal, and precise square instruments. The homepage makes a venue URL feel like a trailhead; the status page uses the same surface and controls to make system evidence easy to inspect. Contours provide orientation while explicit text, borders, and state labels carry meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Warm contour-map paper with a deep evergreen reading voice.
Bright orange reserved for the primary route action and directional linework.
Square, one-pixel instruments with visible focus and pressed states.
Inter Variable for interface text; monospace only for diagnostic values.
Evidence-first status labels explicit in both themes.

rules.name: The Shared Trailhead Rule
rules.body: Homepage and status use the same --app-* palette, contour surface, header, border, focus, and control treatment.

rules.name: The Signal Reserve Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red communicate named state only. Orange is the brand route accent.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Map texture stays quiet behind content; provenance, uncertainty, and state win the contrast hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use paper tone or a one-pixel line. Shadow belongs to temporary overlays.

dos: Do use the shared --app-* tokens for both / and /status.
Do keep the Trailhead paper, evergreen ink, orange route, square geometry, and 56px navigation bar consistent.
Do preserve explicit status labels and use semantic colors only for named states.
Do keep focus visible, errors announced, and evidence copy readable in both themes.
donts: Don't introduce a second route palette or revert /status to a monochrome-only shell.
Don't use orange as a proxy for Connected, Checking, Error, Unknown, or Conflicting.
Don't add resting card shadows, rounded SaaS cards, gradients, or pill-heavy controls.
Don't let contour lines reduce text contrast or hide uncertainty.
